2607.11501.title: Comparative Analysis of GAT and BERT for Human-Like Playtesting
2607.11501.paper_summary: Accurately modeling and understanding player experience is crucial for designing engaging puzzle games. To achieve this, a common approach involves collecting diverse user data to train predictive playtesting models that mimic player behavior. However, existing data-driven methods often lack the ability to capture the full range of player strategies and require extensive feature engineering and network architecture modeling. This limitation becomes particularly evident when new game mechanics or features are introduced, which necessitate continual adjustments to the models. To addrss these challenges, we propose a more generalized representation that reduces - or even eliminates - the need for ongoing feature-engineering maintenance. Specifically, we investigate two general-purpose network architectures: (a) a transformer-based model (BERT) and (b) a graph attention model (GAT), both of which are designed to effectively capture the relational structure of Candy Crush Saga (CCS) game boards. Our experiments compare these approaches to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) baselines, revealing better performance on challenging board configurations and underscoring the benefits of our generalizable representation.
2607.11501.paper_summary_zh: 準確地建模和理解玩家體驗對於設計引人入勝的解謎遊戲至關重要。<lb/>為了實現這一目標，一種常見的方法是收集多樣的用戶數據，以訓練模擬玩家行為的預測遊玩測試模型。<lb/>然而，現有的數據驅動方法往往缺乏捕捉玩家策略全範圍的能力，並且需要大量的特徵工程和網絡架構建模。<lb/>當引入新的遊戲機制或特徵時，這一限制變得尤為明顯，因為這需要對模型進行持續的調整。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了一種更通用的表示方法，減少甚至消除對持續特徵工程維護的需求。<lb/>具體來說，我們研究了兩種通用的網絡架構：(a) 基於Transformer的模型 (BERT) 和 (b) 圖注意力模型 (GAT)，這兩者都旨在有效捕捉《糖果傳奇》（Candy Crush Saga，CCS）遊戲板的關係結構。<lb/>我們的實驗將這些方法與卷積神經網絡（CNN）基準進行比較，顯示在具有挑戰性的棋盤配置上表現更佳，並強調了我們通用表示的優勢。
